$comment: Machine-readable contract between this lab and the clusterdrill application release it installs (opt-in, see bootstrap/deploy-appliance.sh and CLUSTERDRILL_DEPLOY in bootstrap/run.sh), and the Headlamp dashboard it also deploys. See bootstrap/deploy-appliance.sh (the code that actually reads app.version) and bootstrap/README.md. Update this file, and the pinned versions in bootstrap/deploy-appliance.sh, bootstrap/node-common.sh, and dashboard/headlamp-manifest.yaml, together in the same commit whenever any of them change - they must never drift apart. app.version is the only pin the lab tracks for this dependency: the published chart at app.chart_repository already carries that version's real image repository/digest as its own default, so this file deliberately does not duplicate them - see MAINTAINING.md's version-bump runbook.

app.install_method: helm upgrade --install against the published OCI Helm chart (chart_repository, --version app.version) - no --set image.* flags, the chart already has that version's real image baked in as its own default. See bootstrap/deploy-appliance.sh.
app.required_privileges: A single namespaced ClusterRole/ClusterRoleBinding pair scoped to the resource kinds the practice-bank question set actually needs (core, apps, batch, autoscaling, networking.k8s.io, policy, rbac.authorization.k8s.io, storage.k8s.io, apiextensions.k8s.io, plus explicitly-named questions/helm-crds CRD groups) - no cluster-admin binding, no wildcard apiGroup. See the clusterdrill repository's clusterdrill/helm/clusterdrill-chart/templates/clusterrole.yaml and its README's Security limits section.

dashboard.install_method: static manifest (dashboard/headlamp-manifest.yaml), applied by bootstrap/deploy-headlamp.sh - not Headlamp's own Helm chart, which defaults to a cluster-admin ClusterRoleBinding (kubernetes-sigs/headlamp#4435).
dashboard.required_privileges: A single ClusterRole/ClusterRoleBinding pair, read-only (get/list/watch), covering the same resource kinds as the appliance's own ClusterRole including secrets - see dashboard/headlamp-manifest.yaml's own ClusterRole for the deliberate reasoning.
dashboard.auth_method: ServiceAccount bearer token, generated on demand by the operator (kubectl create token headlamp -n headlamp-system) - never printed by deploy-headlamp.sh, since kubectl create token tokens are short-lived by design.

kubernetes.bootstrap_pinned_patch: kubelet/kubeadm/kubectl resolve to whatever pkgs.k8s.io's stable:/v1.33 apt channel serves at install time - the minor is pinned (bootstrap/node-common.sh's KUBERNETES_MINOR), the exact patch is not
kubernetes.supported_range: Any Kubernetes minor where apps/v1, rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1, and core v1 are the stable API versions (true since 1.19) - the manifest uses only those, no alpha/beta APIs. Not independently tested across a version matrix beyond the pinned bootstrap minor above.
